image_description: A close-up photograph of a pale cream to light beige coral fungus (Ramaria or Clavulina species) growing on a forest floor among decaying leaves and green foliage. The fungus features a dense cluster of upright, cylindrical branches that fork repeatedly, originating from a thick, unified base. The texture appears smooth and matte.

While some coral fungi are white/cream, it fails the specific 'brightly colored' descriptor in the checkpoint.
